title: Fix the Null Object Reference
description: The program should create an Account object and print its balance.
expectedBehavior: The program should print the account's balance, 0.0, after it is properly created.
actualProblem: Account acc; only declares the reference variable — it never creates an actual Account object with new. acc is null, so accessing acc.balance throws a NullPointerException.
explanation: Declaring a reference variable does not create an object — it must be explicitly instantiated with new before its fields or methods can be accessed. Using an uninitialized (null) reference raises a NullPointerException.
